info.title: Benefits Platform Benefits API
info.description:
The 'Benefits' web service is a component of the Benefits Platform designed to retrieve detailed 
		                information about plans, offerings, and metadata surrounding these items. The Benefits 
		                Platform encompasses various benefits management systems such as HSA, FSA, HRA management, 
		                and COBRA coverage.

get.summary: Retrieve elections for a specific enrollment
get.description:
Retrieve elections for a specific enrollment ID.
This matches the GetElectionDataLoader pattern for enrollment-specific election access.

parameters.name: enrollment_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the enrollment

parameters.name: effective_date_from
parameters.description: Filter elections effective from this date

parameters.name: effective_date_to
parameters.description: Filter elections effective before this date

parameters.name: active_zero_contrib_fl
parameters.description: Filter by active zero contribution flag

parameters.name: election_amount_min
parameters.description: Filter by minimum election amount

parameters.name: election_amount_max
parameters.description: Filter by maximum election amount

parameters.name: employer_contrib_amt
parameters.description: Filter by exact employer contribution amount

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort order for results. Valid values can be obtained from ElectionSortByHelper.GetValidSortByValues()

parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request, comprised of alphanumeric or hyphen characters up to 36 characters in length.

get.description:
Retrieve enrollments with required filtering by consumer, consumer identifier and optional filtering by plan, plan year and employer.
**Required**: consumer_id and consumer_identifier_type must be provided.

parameters.name: consumer_id
parameters.description: Filter by consumer ID. Required.

parameters.name: consumer_identifier_type
parameters.description: Type of consumer identifier (EMPLOYEE_NUMBER, EMPLOYER_EMPLOYEE_ID, PERSON_ID). Required.

schema.description: Type of consumer identifier: EMPLOYEE_NUMBER (0), EMPLOYER_EMPLOYEE_ID (3), PERSON_ID (4)

parameters.name: employer_id
parameters.description: Filter by employer ID

parameters.name: plan_year_id
parameters.description: Filter by plan year ID

parameters.name: plan_id
parameters.description: Filter by plan ID

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: The sorting criteria

items.description: Sorting options for Consumer Enrollments endpoint

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20, max: 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0)

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request, comprised of alphanumeric or hyphen characters up to 36 characters in length.

get.summary: Retrieve plan years for a consumer and a specific employer
get.description: Retrieve plan years associated with a specific consumer/employer with filtering options for relevance.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: The GUID for accessing this specific consumer and its related resources.

parameters.name: employer_id
parameters.description: The GUID for accessing this specific employer and its related resources.

parameters.name: relevance
parameters.description: The relevance to filter by. Defaults to ACTIONABLE

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: The sorting criteria.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to retrieve. Defaults to 20. Must be between 1 and 100.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of items to skip. Defaults to 0. Must be greater than or equal to 0.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request, comprised of alphanumeric or hyphen characters up to 36 characters in length.

404.description: Not Found.  No Plan Year found for the supplied IDs.
